support_question: Claude Code cloud environment (Pro/Max), Anthropic-hosted. An API credential of type Bearer is configured with Allowed websites = three *.vercel.app hosts and one custom header row: Name x-vercel-protection-bypass, Prefix empty, Value = secret (no Authorization row). A command in the session sends its own 'Authorization: Bearer <app token>' to those hosts. Does the agent proxy (a) keep that client Authorization header unchanged, (b) replace it, or (c) remove it, when it injects the custom header? If (b) or (c), is there a credential type or setting that injects only a custom header and leaves the client's Authorization header untouched?
